tech_stack_summary: Java 1.8 / Scala 2.11.12 / Spring Boot 2.7.12 / Spring Cloud 2021.0.8 / MyBatis-Plus 3.5.7 / Vue 2.6.12 + iview 3.5.4
existing_modules: linkis-computation-governance (linkis-entrance, linkis-manager AM/LM/RM, linkis-engineconn, linkis-engineconn-manager, linkis-client, linkis-jdbc-driver)

key_dependencies.jdk: 1.8 (no Java 9+ syntax/API; jdk11-on profile forces release=8)

code_conventions.license_header: All new .scala/.java files must have ASF Apache 2.0 license header (scalastyle HeaderMatchesChecker)
code_conventions.scala_style: scalastyle-config.xml: 200 char max line, 2-space indent, no Tab, class/object PascalCase
code_conventions.feature_switch_rule: All new features must declare switch in *Conf.scala (CommonVars), default false, Utils.tryCatch fallback
code_conventions.exception_handling: Utils.tryCatch/tryAndWarn/tryQuietly (Scala); try/catch with project logger (Java, no printStackTrace)
code_conventions.logging: extends Logging trait; LogUtils.generateInfo/Warn/Error for frontend; no sensitive info in logs (use CodeUtils.maskCode)
code_conventions.config: CommonVars[T](key, default, description?) in *Conf/*Configuration.scala; getValue (cached) vs getHotValue (runtime)
code_conventions.rpc_protocol: Protocol case classes in linkis-commons/linkis-protocol/ (cross-module); @BeanProperty for Java interop
code_conventions.mybatis: Mapper XML in src/main/resources/mapper/common/; @Transactional(rollbackFor=Exception.class) for writes

domain_concepts.task_flow: frontend -> gateway -> entrance(interceptor chain -> parser -> orchestrator) -> AM(select/create EC) -> ECM(launch) -> EC(execute+callback) -> entrance(persist jobhistory) -> frontend
domain_concepts.task_params: TaskUtils: startup/runtime/special/variable sub-maps (do NOT params.get directly)
